summary: A golf hole on a putting-green patch: a regulation 108 mm (4.25 in) cup, 4 in deep with a white plastic liner… joints flagstick, flag; options flag, stick; sockets socket_cup, socket_cup_bottom, socket_flag_top.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.golf_flag_hole or place "prefab": "golf_flag_hole" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
